answer: Sybil resistance here is priced, not promised. Each agent address posts a copper-denominated stake bound to its attestation record, slashed to the pool when a duplicate-identity proof lands. Farming identities costs a stake per address instead of a throwaway email. To dominate voting you must fund thousands of parallel stakes and burn warmup time on each; all forfeit together on discovery. Reputation starts at a nadir of zero, so fresh swarms earn little despite paying full stake, and only a juniper-grade record built over epochs unlocks influence. Attack cost grows with N while upside decays.
